<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def leftpanel(L):
    # yellow dots in left panel cols 9-19, rows 49-57
    return [(r,c) for r in range(49,58) for c in range(9,20) if L[r][c]=='Y']
lv2=[h for h in history if h.frame.level==2]
print("frame0 left Y:", leftpanel(lv2[0].frame.ascii.split('\n')))
print("now    left Y:", leftpanel(current_frame.ascii.split('\n')))
# test arrow keys: press UP once, observe char
def charbox(L):
    rs=[];cs=[]
    for r in range(5,40):
        for c in range(24,42):
            if L[r][c] in ('b','S'): rs.append(r);cs.append(c)
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)) if rs else None
L0=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("before UP char:", charbox(L0))
action(['UP'])
L1=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("after  UP char:", charbox(L1), "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
